scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w apps/mf-header -w apps/mf-navigation -w apps/mf-home -w apps/mf-patient -w apps/mf-emergency
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -n header,navigation,home,patient,emergency -c blue,cyan,green,yellow,red "npm --workspace apps/mf-header run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-navigation run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-home run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-patient run preview" "npm --workspace apps/mf-emergency run preview"
scripts.start: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -n remotes,shell -c bgBlue,bgGreen "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run dev:shell"
